text: Voor mij te veel gedoe om alleen al te starten. plus geen optie tot nl als taal. snap de helft niet.
author: Mijke Twaalfhoven
developer_reply: We’re sorry the setup feels like such a hassle, especially when the language makes it harder to follow. We really appreciate the feedback on Dutch support and will keep it in mind as we continue improving the experience.

text: truly amazing (if the reminders work) but setting them up, exploring yourself, goals,... all are amazing. it's almost completely what I have been looking for, love the ai for setting up and breaking down tasks and giving reminders and remembering stuff. the only thing missing is a reminders tab, where you can manage your todo's, things you want to remember, notes, maybe shopping lists,... like the really practical stuff. if that could be added in the future it truly will be the best ADHD manager
author: Jonas Verheyden
developer_reply: It means a lot to hear that Indy is so close to what you've been looking for. We're especially glad the AI's help with breaking down tasks and remembering things has been useful. And your idea of a dedicated reminders, notes, shopping lists, and other practical essentials is incredibly thoughtful. Thanks for sharing such detailed feedback!

text: The app is amazing to prioritize tasks and keep track of them, a very nice way to structure the chaos. Since the recent update, things work very slowly...
author: Leatitia Caslo
developer_reply: Thank you for your feedback! We’re glad to hear the app helps you structure your tasks. We’re sorry it’s been running slowly since the update—could you share a specific instance? For example, does it lag when typing, creating a lifeline, or elsewhere? Or you can also send us an email here: support@shimmer.care
